dict.string: Create Google files and open Drive in your default browser.

# Google Workspace Shortcuts | Alfred Workflow
Create Google documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and forms, or open Google Drive, directly from Alfred. Each command opens Google's destination in your default browser.
## Usage
Open Alfred with **Option + Space**, type a keyword below, and press **Return**. These commands take no arguments: give a new file its title after it opens in the browser.
### Create a document (`gdoc`)
Start a new Google Docs document for notes, a brief, or a first draft.
- **Keyword:** `gdoc` - **Destination:** [https://docs.new](https://docs.new)
### Create a spreadsheet (`gsheet`)
Start a new Google Sheets spreadsheet for a tracker, budget, or analysis.
- **Keyword:** `gsheet` - **Destination:** [https://sheets.new](https://sheets.new)
### Create a presentation (`gslides`)
Start a new Google Slides presentation.
- **Keyword:** `gslides` - **Destination:** [https://slides.new](https://slides.new)
### Create a form (`gform`)
Start a new Google Form for a survey, questionnaire, or registration.
- **Keyword:** `gform` - **Destination:** [https://forms.new](https://forms.new)
### Open Google Drive (`gdrive`)
Open Drive to browse or search your existing files in the browser.
- **Keyword:** `gdrive` - **Destination:** [https://drive.google.com/](https://drive.google.com/)
## Examples
- `gdoc` → Return → write meeting notes in the new document. - `gsheet` → Return → start a project tracker. - `gslides` → Return → start a presentation. - `gform` → Return → create a feedback form. - `gdrive` → Return → find an existing file in Drive.
The four creation commands start the new-file flow when you press Return. Typing a keyword alone only shows the Alfred result. There are no extra modifier-key actions or global hotkeys configured for this workflow.
## Setup
Requires macOS, Alfred 5 with an activated Powerpack, and a browser with access to Google Workspace. Sign in to Google in the browser when prompted. Your browser session determines the account used; this workflow does not choose an account or store Google credentials.
On this Mac, the workflow is already installed in Alfred's Stow-managed preferences. On another Mac, deploy the `alfred` module and point Alfred's preferences folder to `~/.config/alfred`; activate your Powerpack separately.
## Customisation
In Alfred Preferences → Workflows → Google Workspace Shortcuts, double-click a **Keyword** object to change its keyword or result label. Double-click its connected **Open URL** object to change the destination or browser. Keep each keyword connected to the corresponding action.
## Troubleshooting
- **No Alfred result:** Check that the workflow is enabled and the keyword has not been changed. Type just the keyword, without a title or other arguments. - **Wrong Google account:** Switch accounts in the browser. If needed, choose a browser with the desired session in the Open URL action. - **Sign-in or access page instead of a new file:** Complete Google's sign-in flow or check the account's Workspace access in your browser. - **Looking for files inside Alfred:** This workflow opens Drive in the browser. It does not search Drive files inside Alfred or provide a starred-files menu.
## Saved configuration
This workflow's source lives in `~/.dotfiles/alfred/.config/alfred/Alfred.alfredpreferences/workflows/user.workflow.google-workspace/`.
Alfred saves the workflow, including this guide, in `info.plist`; `icon.png` supplies its icon. Both files are included in the repository's Git allowlist. Changes made in Alfred update these local files directly, but still need a Git commit and push to reach the remote repository. New workflow folders are ignored by default until reviewed and allowlisted.
